import pandas as pd, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
x=pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cols=['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
for c in cols:
 d=x[['yield_kg','farm',c]].dropna()
 m=smf.ols(f'yield_kg ~ {c} + C(farm)',data=d).fit()
 print(c, round(m.params[c],4), round(m.pvalues[c],6), 'n',len(d))

import pandas as pd, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
x=pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv'); cols=['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
# simultaneous association maybe expose collider/confounding clues
m=smf.ols('yield_kg ~ '+' + '.join(cols)+' + C(farm)',data=x).fit()
print(m.summary())
